newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Petroleum Recovery sets merger.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Petroleum Recovery sets merger.

text.p: Imperial Petroleum Recovery Corp said it has signed a Letter of Intent to purchase 80 percent of Val Verde Corp for undisclosed terms.
Val Verde specializes in the engineering, fabrication, and operation of skid-mounted petroleum refineries and petroleum recovery plants.

Imperial manufactures and markets an RF energy-based oil emulsion-breaking system which addresses the problem of world-wide increasing inventories of crude oil sludge. The system uses high-power RF energy and a proprietary computer control system to efficiently break the stubborn molecular bonds characteristic of oily sludges to release saleable oil and dramatically reduce the volume of disposable materials.
